caption: Both runs start at w = 1 and see the same gradient g = 0.4 with η = 0.1. Momentum's velocity grows to 1.084, so after three steps its weight reaches 0.7756 while plain SGD only reaches 0.88 — the orange curve pulls away as the velocity builds.

spec.aria: A line plot of weight w against step number: plain SGD goes 1, 0.96, 0.92, 0.88 while momentum goes 1, 0.96, 0.884, 0.7756, so the momentum curve drops faster after the first step.
